entries.activation: Writes bridge status on startup and visible status changes; a 30s fallback heartbeat keeps CLI and GUI liveness checks fresh.
entries.inactivityShutdown: No 2s idle write loop; the daemon keeps one status controller for process liveness and cancels it on process exit.
entries.backoff: bounded 30s fallback heartbeat with evented writes for state, chat, error, sync, and peer-count changes.
entries.sharedTimer: dedicated protocol heartbeat rationale: external CLI and GUI liveness checks read the status file without authenticated websocket access.
entries.releaseBehavior: Release writes on status changes and at most one fallback heartbeat about every 30s while the daemon is alive.
